questions.question: The graph of the linear function f passes through the points (0, −1) and (1, −7). Which equation defines f?
questions.explanation: The slope is (−7 − (−1))/1 = −6 and the y-intercept is −1. (The graph was unclear in the scan, so Humo wrote a similar one.)

questions.question:
b − 38 = (x)/(y)
The given equation relates the positive numbers b, x, and y. Which equation correctly expresses x in terms of b and y?
questions.explanation: Multiply both sides by y: x = y(b − 38) = by − 38y.

questions.question: Line t in the xy-plane has a slope of −12 and passes through the point (8, 3). Which equation defines line t?
The shaded region shown represents the solutions to the inequality ry < 128, where r is a constant. What is the value of r?
questions.explanation: The boundary is y = −8 and the region above it is shaded, so y > −8. Dividing ry < 128 by a negative r gives y > 128/r, so 128/r = −8 and r = −16.

questions.question: For a particular tree species, it is recommended to plant a maximum of 111 trees per acre. Based on this recommendation, what is the maximum number of trees of this species that can be planted on 2 acres?

5x + 7y = 8
30x + 42y = 48
For each real number r, which of the following points lies on the graph of each equation in the xy−plane for the given system?
questions.explanation: The second equation is 6 times the first, so both are the same line. Solving 5x + 7y = 8 for y with x = r gives y = −(5r)/7 + 8/7.

questions.question: A delivery van can carry at most 1,200 pounds. The driver weighs 180 pounds, and each box to be loaded weighs 45 pounds. What is the maximum number of boxes that can be loaded into the van with the driver?
questions.topic: Linear inequalities in one or two variables

questions.question:
√x2 = 80 − 9x
What is the solution to the given equation?
questions.explanation: √(x²) = |x|. If x ≥ 0, x = 80 − 9x gives x = 8. If x < 0, −x = 80 − 9x gives x = 10, which is not negative, so x = 8 is the only solution.

questions.question: For the polynomial function f, the graph of y = f(x) in the xy−plane passes through the points (−4, 0), (3, 0), and (5, 0). Which of the following must be a factor of f(x)?
questions.explanation: The graph crosses the x-axis at x = 3, so f(3) = 0 and x − 3 is a factor.

questions.question: g(x) = 27x + 85 and h(x) = 5x − 7. The functions g and h are defined by the equations shown. Which expression is equivalent to g(x) · h(x)?
Which expression is equivalent to 7x6 − 14x2, where x > 0?

In the given scatterplot, a line of best fit for the data is shown.
Which of the following equations best represents this line of best fit?
questions.explanation: The line passes through the origin and rises about 1.1 for each 1 in x.

questions.question: A carpenter charges a flat rate of $306 for the first 3 hours of work and $85 for each additional hour of work. Which equation gives the total amount y, in dollars, that the carpenter charges for x hours of work, where x > 3?

The cost to rent a bus from Company X is $750 for the first 2 hours and an additional $50 per hour for each hour after the first 2 hours. If the total cost to rent the bus from Company X for t hours, where t > 2, is $1,050, which equation represents this situation?
questions.explanation: $750 covers 2 hours and each of the remaining t − 2 hours costs $50.

questions.question: A science club from a certain high school in Ohio conducted an experiment to study the effects of smell on taste. A sample of 100 students was selected at random from the high school to participate in the experiment. First, the students tasted a pureed food sample while wearing covered goggles and nose plugs. Then, the students tasted the same pureed food sample without nose plugs. 30 students were able to correctly identify the pureed food sample while wearing nose plugs. Which of the following is the largest population to which the results of the experiment can be generalized?
options: All students from high schools in Ohio
The 30 students who were able to correctly identify the pureed food sample while wearing nose plugs
All students from the high school
The 100 students who participated in the experiment
questions.explanation: The sample was selected at random from the students of that one high school, so results can be generalized only to all students at that high school.

questions.question: During hibernation, American black bears do not eat or replenish calories. A certain black bear weighed 515 pounds when entering hibernation and lost weight at a rate of 0.5 pound per day. At this rate, how many days after entering hibernation did the black bear weigh 490 pounds?
questions.explanation: The bear lost 515 − 490 = 25 pounds, and 25 ÷ 0.5 = 50 days.

questions.question: The measure of an angle is 24° less than three times the measure of its supplement. What is the measure of the angle?
The perimeter of a square can be expressed as 4(76) units. What is the length, in units, of a side of this square?

A hollow steel pipe is in the shape of a right circular cylinder. The steel pipe has an outside diameter of 48 inches, a wall thickness of ⅝ inches, and a height of 144 inches. Which of the following is closest to the volume, in cubic inches, of the wall of this steel pipe?
An area of 58.00 square nautical miles is equivalent to k square kilometers. To the nearest tenth, what is the value of k? (1 nautical mile = 1.852 kilometers)
questions.explanation: Square the conversion factor: k = 58.00 × 1.852^2 = 58 × 3.4299 ≈ 198.9.

y > 92x + b
In the given inequality, b is a positive constant. Which of the following does NOT contain any points (x, y) in the xy−plane that are solutions to this inequality?
questions.explanation: If x > 0 and b > 0, then (9/2)x + b is positive, so y must be greater than a positive number. No point with y < 0 can satisfy the inequality.

questions.question:
The bar graph shows the distribution of flower type for the 700 flowers that a florist has in stock.
For which two types of flowers is the total number of flowers of the two types exactly 25 of the florist’s stock?
questions.explanation: 2/5 of 700 is 280, and orchid (100) + lily (180) = 280. (The answer choices were cut off in the scan, so Humo wrote the other three.)

questions.question:
(x − 3) − 8(y + 9) = 129
(x − 3) + 8(y + 9) = 432
The solution to the given system of equations is (x, y). What is the value of 8(x − 3)?
questions.explanation: Adding the equations gives 2(x − 3) = 561, so x − 3 = 280.5 and 8(x − 3) = 2244.

questions.question: If x ≥ −6 represents all solutions to the inequality ax − 27 ≤ 15, where a is a constant, what is the greatest possible value of a?
questions.explanation: ax ≤ 42. For the solutions to be x ≥ −6, a must be negative, so x ≥ 42/a. Then 42/a = −6 and a = −7.

questions.question: A student council group is selling car stickers for a fundraiser. They use the function p(x) = 5x − 240 to determine their profit p(x), in dollars, for selling x car stickers. In order to earn a profit of $700, how many car stickers must they sell?

0.5x + 1.2y = 9
1.5x + 3.6y = 27
How many solutions does the given system of equations have?
questions.explanation: Multiplying the first equation by 3 gives the second equation exactly, so the lines coincide and there are infinitely many solutions.

questions.question: Function f is defined as f(x) = (2x − 5)2, and function g is defined as g(x) = 2(2x + 7). Which of the following is equivalent to f(x) + g(x)?
Which quadratic equation has no real solutions?
questions.explanation: For −2x^2 + 2x − 2 = 0 the discriminant is 4 − 16 = −12 < 0, so there are no real solutions. The others each have real solutions.

(x − k)2 = (k − 5a)(x − k)
In the given equation, a and k are constants, where k > 5a. The sum of the solutions to the equation is 3k + 21. What is the value of a?
questions.explanation: The solutions are x = k and x = 2k − 5a, so 3k − 5a = 3k + 21 and a = −21/5.

The table shows the distribution of height, in centimeters, of 25 objects. Which of the following could be the median height of these objects?
questions.explanation: With 25 objects, the median is the 13th value. The first group has 8 and the first two groups have 14, so the 13th value is in 101 to 200. Only 155 fits.

questions.question: At different times on a certain day, a manager at a theme park recorded the number of visitors. An exponential model gives the estimated number of visitors, V, at the theme park t hours after the theme park opened, where t ≤ 3. Based on the model, 85 visitors were estimated to be at the theme park when it opened, and every 30 minutes the estimated number of visitors increased by 140% of the estimated number of visitors 30 minutes earlier. Which of the following equations best represents this model?
questions.explanation: A 140% increase multiplies the amount by 1 + 1.40 = 2.40 every 30 minutes. In t hours there are 2t such periods, so V = 85(2.40)<sup>2t</sup>.

At a nature preserve, a wildlife biologist counted ducks from an observation deck at the same time each day for 41 days. The table summarizes the resulting data set, data set A.
The data value 13 was recorded in error and is removed from data set A to create data set B, which consists of the remaining 40 data values. Which statement best compares the median of data set A and the median of data set B?
options: The median of data set B is greater than the median of data set A.
There is not enough information to compare the medians of the two data sets.
The median of data set B is equal to the median of data set A.
The median of data set B is less than the median of data set A.
questions.explanation: The median of A is the 21st value, which is 3. The median of B is the average of the 20th and 21st values, both 3, so it is also 3.

questions.question: The scatterplot for data set A consists of the weights y, in pounds, of a Labrador retriever puppy at various ages x, in months. The equation of a line of best fit for the relationship in data set A can be written as y = −5.0 + 8.7x, where 2 ≤ x ≤ 6. The puppy was weighed again at 9 months old and weighed 52 pounds. Data set B consists of all the data points in data set A as well as the data point (9, 52). The equation of a line of best fit for data set B can be written as y = r + sx, where r and s are constants and 2 ≤ x ≤ 9. Assuming the equations of the lines of best fit are calculated in the same way, which of the following is the best estimate for the value of s?
A circle in the xy-plane has its center at (19, 16) and has a radius of 8k. Which equation represents this circle?
questions.explanation: The right side is the radius squared: (8k)^2 = 64k^2.

questions.question: A cube has an edge length of 82 inches. A solid sphere with a radius of 41 inches is inside the cube, such that the sphere touches the center of each face of the cube. To the nearest cubic inch, what is the volume of the space in the cube <u>not</u> taken up by the sphere?
questions.explanation: Cube: 82^3 = 551,368. Sphere: (4/3)π(41)^3 ≈ 288,695. The difference is about 262,672 cubic inches.

questions.question:
T(x) = 67 − 8x
The function T estimates the temperature, in degrees Fahrenheit (°F), in a certain city one day in January, where x is the number of hours after 10 a.m. and 1 ≤ x ≤ 5. According to the function, what was the estimated decrease in temperature each hour, in °F, in this city during this time period?
questions.explanation: The coefficient of x is −8, so the temperature falls 8°F each hour.

questions.question: The measure of angle K is π3(17) radians. The measure of angle L is 17 times the measure of angle K. What is the measure, in degrees, of angle L?
questions.explanation: Angle L = 17 × π/(3(17)) = π/3 radians, which is (π/3)(180/π) = 60 degrees.
